title: Create a high-quality overhead fashion p
prompt:
Create a high-quality overhead fashion portrait, 9:16 vertical format.

An adult East Asian young woman lying on soft lace bedding, photographed from directly above. She is placed slightly diagonally in the frame, with a relaxed and elegant pose. Her long hair spreads naturally across the bedding, with soft volume, loose strands, and a realistic lived-in texture.

She wears a refined satin slip dress with thin straps, lace trim, small bow details, and soft layered fabric. The upper part of the dress should have natural, realistic fabric support, gently following the body lines with a smooth and elegant silhouette. The shape should feel stable, soft, and natural, not exaggerated, not stiff, not collapsed, and not deformed.

Use rich fabric texture: lace embroidery, silk or satin highlights, soft wrinkles, delicate folds, and natural shadows. The bedding should feel layered and tactile, not flat.

Lighting direction:
soft natural window light / warm vintage light / blue night ambience with a bedside lamp.

Color mood:
black lace on white bedding / cream satin in morning light / burgundy velvet with warm vintage light / deep blue satin with cinematic night lighting.

The portrait should feel dreamy, quiet, cinematic, and realistic, like an editorial fashion photo. Keep natural skin texture, real facial details, soft eye contact, and a believable human presence.

Avoid: low-quality selfie look, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, CGI look, distorted hands, wrong body proportions, deformed clothing, messy fabric logic, overexposure, cheap studio lighting, cartoon style.
